req.title: Include origin IP in echoed metadata
req.statement: The system shall include the client origin (X-Forwarded-For if present, else remote_addr) in the 'origin' field of all echo endpoints.
triggers: include origin ip in echoed metadata

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must include the client origin IP in the 'origin' field, preferring X-Forwarded-For header over remote_addr. The key logic in helpers.py is: origin=request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', request.remote_addr). Tests must cover: (1) positive - X-Forwarded-For present and echoed exactly, (2) positive - remote_addr used when X-Forwarded-For absent, (3) negative - wrong header name does not satisfy requirement, (4) boundary - X-Forwarded-For present with empty string vs absent, (5) decision table covering all five endpoints, (6) boundary - multiple IPs in X-Forwarded-For chain. Mutation targets: string constant 'X-Forwarded-For', field name 'origin', fallback to remote_addr, exact value comparison.

tests.name: test_get_origin_uses_x_forwarded_for_when_present
preconditions: X-Forwarded-For header is set to a known IP
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: X-Forwarded-For present -> origin = X-Forwarded-For value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_origin_uses_x_forwarded_for_when_present():
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': '1.2.3.4'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == '1.2.3.4'

test_get_origin_uses_x_forwarded_for_when_present()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_origin_field_not_present_when_wrong_header_name():

    assert r.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_with_xff
actions: Send GET /get, POST /post, PUT /put, PATCH /patch, DELETE /delete each with X-Forwarded-For: 5.6.7.8
For each response assert status 200 and origin == '5.6.7.8'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: all echo endpoints must include origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_with_xff():
    xff = '5.6.7.8'
    headers = {'X-Forwarded-For': xff}
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method, headers=headers)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} status={r.status_code}'
        data = r.get_json()
        assert 'origin' in data, f'{method} {path} missing origin'
        assert data['origin'] == xff, f'{method} {path} origin={data["origin"]}'

test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_with_xff()

trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: X-Forwarded-For with chain must be echoed verbatim; boundary on multi-value header
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_origin_xff_multi_ip_chain_echoed_exactly():
    xff = '10.0.0.1, 10.0.0.2, 10.0.0.3'
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': xff})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == xff

trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: X-Forwarded-For completely replaces remote_addr; no merging
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_origin_xff_overrides_remote_addr_not_merged():

    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == xff

tests.name: test_origin_key_exact_name_in_response
actions: Assert response JSON contains key 'origin' (not 'Origin', not 'ip', not 'remote_addr')
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: field must be named 'origin' exactly; catches field-name mutation
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_origin_key_exact_name_in_response():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert 'Origin' not in data
    assert 'ip' not in data
    assert 'remote_addr' not in data
    assert data['origin'] is not None
